messages:
sam: Heads up — saw a latency spike on prod for flashv3 causal when head_dim = 14 (odd head sizes). Trace points to kernel chooser flipping to cpu_fallback for ~10% of microbatches.

maria: ugh. any repro? logs?

sam: quick snippet from perf trace:
```
kernel_pick: flashv3_causal path
heuristic_score: 0.42
fallback: cpu_ternary
reason: prefetch_stride_mismatch
batch_shape: (microbatch=8, seq=512, head_dim=14)
```

jon: prefetch_stride_mismatch? that sounds like the prefetch alignment probe failing because head_dim%4 !=0. We saw similar with prefetch buffer wrap on sm86.

mina: can you paste pprof heatmap or nvprof lines?

sam: here's nvprof sample:
```
CUDA kernel time: 0.89ms  (flashv3)
... then sudden 12.3ms (cpu fallback)
memory transfers small but many
```

maria: Is this KV cache related? we've seen variable kv lengths across batch cause mispredictions in kernel picker.

sam: yes — this only reproduces when KV cache present and some requests have long past tokens; the picker probes seqlen bucket and prefetch pads; padding pattern apparently triggers stride calc that fails flash kernel prefetch guard.

jon: hypothesis: our autotuner probe uses a single sample per head_dim/seqlen combo. When head_dim odd (14,22) the probe sees a wrap and reports negative affinity for flashv3. On heterogeneous batches it flips.

mina: workaround idea: add hysteresis to picker: don't change kernel unless new choice is 20% faster consistently over N=3 probes. Also add a quick microprobe for kv_cache padding patterns.

maria: +1. We should also blacklist cpu_fallback for these specific head sizes as temporary mitigation (risky) or prefer flashv2 noncausal where applicable.

sam: created a small test harness: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rt/issues/4523 (link in thread)

perf-bot: Test run #4523 started on runner-12 — output in 2h

jon: plan: 1) add hystersis + probe repeat 2) add KV-pattern microprobe 3) add perf regression alert tied to this probe 4) canary rollout

mina: can we add unit reproduction in eng-runtime CI with both sm86 and sm90 docker runners? will catch arch differences.

sam: I'm on 1+2. Opening PR for picker hysteresis now.

maria: assign to sam & jon; tag infra for canary schedule.

sam: minor note — this affects only causal flashv3 kernel. Non-causal paths look fine.

jon: good. Also add logging gate to record reason codes when fallback chosen so we can monitor frequency.

mina: lgtm. emojis: :thumbsup:

sam: final: timeline — PR today, internal CI tomorrow, canary next Wed, rollback plan in case of regressions. I'll update issue link.

perf-bot: Test run #4523 completed: 6/6 passes. Summary: latency reduced after hysteresis patch in controlled runners.

maria: awesome, thanks. Keep an eye on production graphs this week. :eyes:
